findings.basis: Runner sent lastName 'Runner2' where its own authored step says 'Runner'. The digit violates the module's name whitelist (letters/marks/space/apostrophe/hyphen/period only — no digits), in place since 2026-03-17. Not a product failure; the only surviving product defect is the missing field-level error detail.
findings.superseded_basis: UpdateContactCommandHandler never references UserManager/ApplicationUser/FindBy*/UpdateAsync; VALIDATION originates in NewContactValidator.

findings.basis: Runner sent firstName 'SMK017' instead of @td(ADDR_NY.first_name) (= 'Jane'). Same name-whitelist rule as SMK-025. A clean alpha-name US address appends successfully on this build (probed: HTTP 200, address created).
findings.superseded_basis: Same root cause as SMK-025 — one defect, two symptoms.

findings.basis: GA4 transaction_id/value; no identity code involved.
Storefront blanks after account delete; platform-side delete verified correct (200, null re-read, search 0). Dedups against BUG_011b_INCIDENTAL_001 (2026-08-03).
Missing VCST-4531 session-invalidation warning banner; UI copy.

regression_triage.misattribution_corrected: Two corrections, both away from PR #3077. (1) Suite 042's bug recorded a 'STRONG TRIAGE LEAD' naming PR #3077 — refuted from source. (2) The replacement framing ('systemic member-write regression, window = the 3.1057.0->3.1058.0 delta') was ALSO refuted, by live probe: both mutations work on valid data and the validation rules are ~5 months old. Nothing in this build's delta caused either failure.

investigation_followup.method: Live Layer-3 GraphQL probe against the same build (3.1058.0-pr-3077-8295 / ProfileExperienceApi 3.1015.0-pr-141-d7d8), plus module source history.
investigation_followup.conclusion: Neither SMK-025 nor SMK-017 evidenced a broken write path. updateContact with identical values, updateContact lastName='Tester', updateMemberAddresses echoing the existing 3 addresses, and updateMemberAddresses appending a new alpha-name US address all returned HTTP 200. The sole trigger is a digit (or _ or @) in a NAME field, rejected by InputValidationOptions.NameValidationPattern.
investigation_followup.not_a_regression: The pattern rules landed 2026-03-17 (PR #130 / VCST-4691, XSS hardening) and were last touched 2026-03-25 (PR #132). No commit since has changed NewContactValidator or AddressValidator. Neither vc-platform PR #3077 nor ProfileExperienceApi PR #141 is implicated.
investigation_followup.baseline_caveat: The 2026-08-03 'PASS' for both cases cannot serve as a baseline: those rows in REG-2026-08-03-1900/suite-042-results.json are bare {id,status} with no notes, payload or evidence, unlike every other case in that file.
investigation_followup.surviving_product_defect: The rejection returns a bare VALIDATION code with no field detail, so the storefront can only show 'Something went wrong' and the user cannot self-correct. Filed as VCST-5690 at Medium; it is the unfinished half of VCST-4819's own suggested fix.
investigation_followup.pass_rate_note: The `regression` block's pass/fail counts and 94.6% pass rate are left AS MEASURED and are NOT restated. Reclassifying two failures post hoc would inflate the rate without a re-run; the honest correction is that 2 of the 6 failures are test-data defects, so a re-run with the authored fixture values is what would legitimately move the number. The release-gate blockers are unaffected (078 never ran).
investigation_followup.suite_fix_applied: regression/suites/Frontend/smoke/042-smoke-tests.csv — SMK-017 and SMK-025 now carry explicit [NOTE] lines forbidding an improvised or run-scoped name and requiring letters-only first/last names. suites:lint green.

open_risks.detail: Every Find* now pays a CloneTyped() deep clone incl. Roles→Permissions, on the per-request auth path. PR ships CloneUser as the override seam. Recommend /qa-perf-measure before a high-traffic deployment.

The PR's self-declared userManager.Users gap is live-reachable in 4 deployed places (vc-module-pages PageDocumentSeoResolver, vc-module-x-cms GetPageDocumentQueryHandler, profile-experience-api uniqueness handlers, platform UserSearchService). All read-only today ⇒ future risk.

The defect has no black-box reproduction path on this deployment (PUT /users passes a detached user; vc-module-sales-rep retains its CloneTyped workaround). Every live check is a regression check; the repair itself is proven only by CustomUserManagerCloneOnReadTests.
PlatformDeveloperGuide documents the natural Find → mutate → Update pattern with no detachment warning — this is a genuine undocumented platform defect, and the docs should state the new contract.

incidents.what: Self-inflicted environment outage during this run
incidents.detail: The first repin deployed PR 3077's original image, built BEHIND dev, which removed platform PR 3095's JsonHashExtensions from under the env's pinned XCatalog_3.1016.0-pr-106 (the other half of VCST-5637, which calls searchRequest.GetJsonSha256Hex()). Result: System.TypeLoadException at XCatalog…BuildSearchCacheKey and 500s on SearchProducts/GetProduct/GetCategory/GetShortCart/GetFullCart from 14:50:48Z. Caught by /qa-monitoring; fixed by updating PR 3077's branch onto dev and redeploying 3.1058.0-pr-3077-8295.
incidents.lesson: Same-ticket paired prereleases must deploy together. /qa-deploy-pr's dry-run showed only a 2-line platform-tag swap with no warning that a pinned module prerelease depended on the tag being replaced — a real tooling gap worth its own ticket.

incidents.what: Runner writes local time with a Z suffix
incidents.detail: Suite 031's startedAt was 92 minutes in the future (UTC+2 local stamped as UTC). Corrupts every duration the report computes and any per-suite timing reaching history.json. Worth fixing in .claude/agents/test-runner-agent.md. regression:reap is unaffected (it classifies from file mtimes).

A typed password rendered as <secret>ADMIN_PASSWORD_VCPTCORE</secret>! — DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD and ADMIN_PASSWORD_VCPTCORE share a value prefix, so the redactor matched the shorter name and left a trailing character unredacted in the transcript. Tighten .env.playwright.local (longest-match, or distinct values).
